title: Virginity
summary: Virginity is a social idea, usually meaning someone hasn't had sex yet. Definitions differ, and there is no medical test for it.
key_points: The hymen, bleeding or 'tightness' don't prove anything.
Your worth isn't tied to your sexual history.
